task_summary: Implement run-length encoding of adjacent equal strings in solution.py and add standard-library unittest coverage in test_solution.py.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
Encode adjacent equal strings as (value, count) pairs; nonadjacent equal values form separate runs; empty input returns [].
Add at least two passing unittest test methods exercising the public API, covering ordinary, boundary, and empty inputs, or invalid numeric inputs if no collection is accepted.
